title: DNA extraction: Campylobacter
author: Ben Pascoe
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.wzbff2n
materials: Method adapted from QIAGEN QIAmp DNA mini prep manual. See Appendix D: page 55.

steps.title: Grow isolates on plates
steps.instruction: Incubate bacterial isolates for 48 h on chocolate, blood, or Brucella agar plates at 42 °C.

steps.title: Harvest bacteria and resuspend
steps.instruction: Collect at least one loop‑full of the cultured bacteria, resuspend in 180 µL Buffer ATL, and incubate for 30 min at 37 °C.

steps.title: Add Proteinase K and vortex
steps.instruction: Add 20 µL Proteinase K (provided in the kit) to the suspension and mix by vortexing.

steps.title: Incubate with Proteinase K
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture at 56 °C for 30–60 min.

steps.title: Add RNase and Buffer AL
steps.instruction: Spin down briefly to remove condensation from caps, then add 4 µL RNase (100 mg · mL⁻¹) and 200 µL Buffer AL (kit), and vortex to mix.

steps.title: Incubate at 70°C
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube at 70 °C for 10 min.

steps.title: Add ethanol and vortex
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL of 95–100 % (v/v) ethanol to the suspension and vortex briefly.

steps.title: Load onto QIAmp column and centrifuge
steps.instruction: Transfer the suspension to a QIAmp column placed in a 2 mL collection tube and centrifuge at 8 000 rpm for 1 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Discard flow-through and transfer column
steps.instruction: Discard the flow‑through and relocate the column into a clean 2 mL collection tube.

steps.title: Wash column with Buffer AW1
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL Buffer AW1 (kit) to the column and centrifuge at 8 000 rpm for 1 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Wash and dry column with Buffer AW2
steps.instruction: Discard the flow‑through, add 500 µL Buffer AW2 (kit), then centrifuge for 3 min at 14 000 rpm (room temperature) to dry the membrane.

steps.title: Elute DNA with Buffer AE
steps.instruction: Place the column in a clean micro‑centrifuge tube and pipette 50 µL Buffer AE (kit) or water onto the membrane.

steps.title: Incubate, elute, and store DNA
steps.instruction: Let the column stand for 1 min at room temperature, then centrifuge at 8 000 rpm for 1 min to elute genomic DNA; store the eluate at 4 °C for short‑term or –20 °C for long‑term storage.
